notes.title: Estellium Legends Hot Fix v1.1!
notes.notes:
It saddens me to have to announce this, but rather then sell a broken product I'd rather just remove it entirely. This is why I am discontinuing support for Linux for Estellium Legends. All the nuts and bolts aka the plugins and scripts that are needed for the game to run are not compatible with Linux based operating systems. So I will be pulling the plug for this platform in this next update.

Deeply sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Estellium Legends Hot Fix v1.0!
notes.notes:
I've heard your complaints and seen the issues. Hopefully this hot fix has helped with most of them.

1. Got rid of the Co-Op in the default build and moved it to the test build only. This will hopefully fix the freezing some people have.

2. Fixed a bug that allowed you to jump over the river and get stuck without activating the scarecrow first.

3. Various other small changes and fixes.

Lastly, in order to play co-op with this game, you will need to update your game to the beta version with the password: animadragon56. Please keep in mind that this build is experimental and is prone to some crashing. But if you want to use Parsec or play with a buddy, you will need this build for local co-op.

Thanks and have a nice day!

notes.title: Estellium Legends v1.8 out now! +All updates concluded.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34287146/f7062e75056513fcd7fb1d04604737e1a346ab61.jpg[/img]
Hello and welcome to the final update of Estellium Legends. Yes, you heard that right. The final one. Because of improper planning of the story mode, I realized I didn't actually have much that needed to be done and was able to finish not just chapter 4 and 5, but the remaining 3 chapters! So please enjoy the completed story mode for free! But that is not all, please look at what else is new:

-Fixed the duplicate game folder issue, drastically decreasing
game file size.

-Buffed all of Black Mage's skills greatly.

-Added in some new skills.

-Fixed the Class command not showing up in Chapter 5.

-Fixed various other things.

-Replaced Rebbi with Lilith.

-Added in Aria and Feris as playable characters.

-Added in Chapters 4, 5 and 6.

-Reworked the camp menu to help with the image stretching. *This is why Rebbi had to get removed.*

-Added in local co-op. *Player followers should be on if you have more then one
player in your game. Otherwise simply turn them off for best solo experience.*

Players can drop in and drop out with a controller using the start and select buttons.

As of right now. Estellium Legends is finished. I will go into another round of testing some day and will patch again if needed. But that is all for now.

Thank you for your continued support of Estellium Legends and please look forward to the next Team Syukino project!

If you would like news on the next Team Syukino project please consider joining the Team Syukino Store Page and group to stay informed on all the latest offers.

*This hub will be used to help notify of sales or other things until an "News updates have been concluded" announcement happens.*

Thank you guys for everything!
